implementation: Per-instance input/output field views retained after the original range and input-membership checks. Active artifact is privately cloned; reset updates the existing fixed memory. Invalid or undeclared fields are never retained. Cached lookup, reset and evaluate also reject detached/replaced memory buffers; fixed-memory programs require re-instantiation after external memory.grow(0).
scope: Only repeated host input field lookup, full100801 scalar copies and public output view retrieval. Same actual full14400 compiler-issued registration artifact, no Modelica source or numerical changes.
limitations: First field access still validates all input elements; preparation excluded from measured window.
Browser latency is diagnostic and overlaps app build; no kernel speedup attributed to view retention.
The selected preview does not yet use NativeProgram for full SLAM; app build succeeded and selected bundle remained unchanged.
No GPU readback, end-to-end throughput or full-SLAM completion claim.
